label: Option the site
help: Locks land (cost set by the site choice at setup). Required before the pad stage. One time only.

label: Fund road and school extensions
help: Town +8. Skip it past month 12 and town takes a one-time -8.

label: File a permit
help: Starts that permit's decision clock.

label: File the power docket
help: Opens the power docket for a vote. Needs the interconnection study pending or done.

label: Prepare testimony
help: Raises the vote odds, up to a cap. Two months in a row costs commission -1.

label: Answer discovery
help: Clears an outstanding discovery request before it slips the vote.

label: Meet an intervenor
help: Progress toward settling with one intervenor.

label: Commission the interconnection study
help: Starts the study clock that gates the docket filing.

label: Order the transformer
help: Long lead time. Order it early.

label: Order the switchgear
help: Long lead time. Order it early.

label: Cancel an order
help: Refunds the deposit minus a cancellation fee.

label: Adjust insurance
help: Turns builder's risk or delay-in-start-up cover on or off.

label: Cure a draw freeze
help: Ends an active draw freeze so construction draws resume.

label: Price the takeout
help: Runs the refinance and rating scene. Only once the takeout window is open.

label: Confirm the rack schedule
help: Reveals rack arrival windows on the ledger and raises Tenant goodwill +3. One time only.

label: Ready liquid cooling
help: Gets a hall ready for liquid-cooled racks (cost depends on tier).

label: Ask for a delay swap
help: Asks the tenant to slide one hall's delivery and outside dates.

label: Advance construction
help: Starts the next construction stage on a hall. Cost flows through draws.

label: Import crews
help: Prevents a labor shortfall from slowing fitout, for 6 months.

label: Stand down a hall
help: Pauses one hall this month to save cash. Resumes free next month.

label: Fix an inspection
help: Clears a failed inspection so the hall can resume.

label: Visit a cast member
help: +4 goodwill to one group. Once per group every 3 months.
